Wrangler Air box

64 × 58 × 35 mm. Sizes of DinMeter, Unit Relay and Unit ADC v1.1 from M5Stack's official drawings and 3D shells. DinMeter in the top face, screen up, its back clip without the screw ears. Relay on the floor, ADC on edge against the front wall above it. Car wires enter through a slot low in the left wall. Hover or tap a part for its name.
